description: The shipped anonymized .tuning.json path hashes table_tunings keys and column names but leaves requested constraint mappings under tables and their column list verbatim. A driven origin/develop payload retained orders and o_orderkey in the public companion. Extend the tuning-specific anonymizer to cover constraint table and column identifiers while preserving enabled flags, tuning values, normalized source references, and byte-for-byte raw output when anonymize=False.
